Part  IV(A) — GAZETTE  EXTRAORDINARY  OF  THE  DEMOCRATIC  SOCIALIST  REPUBLIC  OF  SRI  LANKA - 17.09.2025
AUTHORIZATION
FOR 2025 ADVANCED ACCOUNTS
I do hereby approve the amend the advance account limits for the year 2025 stated in the Sixth schedule of the Second
Supplementary Financial Statement for the year 2025, by virtue of powers vested in me under Section 27 (a) of the Provincial
Council Act No. 42 of 1987, as the term of the 06th Sabaragamuwa Provincial Councilof the Democratic Socialist Republic
of Sri Lanka ended on 26th September, 2017.
Accordingly, I do hereby grant permission to the Chief Secretary and the Accounting Officers of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial
Council to bear the expenses subject to those limits.
A. A. C. J. Rajarathna,
Hon. Governor,
Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council.
30th day of July, 2025.
